output.question: How many employees does Coca-Cola have?
output.answer: The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) had about 65,900 employees as of December 31, 2025, according to its Form 10-K for fiscal 2025, filed with the SEC on February 20, 2026. About 8,900 of them worked in the United States. Headcount fell from about 69,700 at the end of 2024, a drop of roughly 3,800 (about 5.5%). This is the most recent official figure; Coca-Cola reports headcount once a year, so the next update should come with the FY2026 10-K in early 2027.

key_facts.fact: The Coca-Cola Company had approximately 65,900 employees as of December 31, 2025.
About 8,900 of those employees were in the United States.
The company had approximately 69,700 employees as of December 31, 2024.

passages.quote: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, our Company had approximately 65,900 and 69,700 employees, respectively
of which approximately 8,900 were located in the United States.

caveats: The count covers only The Coca-Cola Company and its consolidated subsidiaries. Independent bottling partners such as Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, Coca-Cola FEMSA, Coca-Cola HBC and Coca-Cola Consolidated employ many more people across the Coca-Cola system, and they are not included.
Headcount often swings because Coca-Cola buys and sells bottling operations (refranchising). The drop from 79,100 in 2023 to 65,900 in 2025 largely reflects such changes, not only layoffs.
The figure is as of December 31, 2025. No newer official headcount has been published; the FY2026 10-K is expected around February 2027.
Some data sites label the years differently, for example listing 65,900 under 'fiscal 2026'. The 10-K is clear that 65,900 is the December 31, 2025 figure.
